label: Support Triage
description: Understand a user issue and route it to next steps.

classifier.useWhen: User reports a problem and needs diagnosis or escalation.

label: User Explanation
description: Explain a system behavior or remediation in user-facing terms.

classifier.useWhen: User needs a clear support response or troubleshooting guide.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for internal architecture design.

label: Support Escalation
description: Prepare escalation context, severity, repro notes, and routing for another team.

classifier.useWhen: User issue needs handoff to engineering, operations, security, billing, or product.

label: Support Ticket Reply
description: Draft a response to a user support issue.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to respond to a customer or support ticket.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for internal-only root cause analysis.

label: Support Runbook
description: Write troubleshooting runbooks and remediation steps.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to create support procedures.

label: Support Reproduction
description: Convert a user issue into reproducible steps and expected behavior.

classifier.useWhen: User reports an issue needing repro.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for direct product strategy.

label: Support KB Suggestion
description: Suggest or draft reusable knowledge-base entries from support issues.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to turn support learnings into KB content.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for one-off sales copy.

label: Support Status Update
description: Draft clear incident or issue status updates for users.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to communicate issue status.

label: Customer Apology
description: Draft empathetic apologies, explanations, and next steps.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for apology or customer-facing remediation language.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for technical incident analysis only.

label: FAQ Writing
description: Write FAQs, troubleshooting answers, and support snippets.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for reusable support Q&A.
